issues.description: No tests or test harness were delivered with the solution (no test files in the workspace). Automated verification of correctness across representative inputs is therefore not available here.

The implementation enumerates set partitions by creating new team labels in order of first appearance (teams_in_use mechanism). This is an acceptable approach to count unlabeled partitions (Stirling numbers) but must not include incorrect pruning. The use of a one-element list as a mutable integer (teams_in_use) is functional but non-idiomatic; replacing it with an integer and using nonlocal would be clearer.
